tasks.label: Build GTK4 app
args: export PATH=/ucrt64/bin:$PATH; cd /c/Users/yahya/Desktop/bank && echo 'BUILD STARTED' && mkdir -p build && /ucrt64/bin/gcc -fdiagnostics-color=always -g src/*.c -Iinclude $(/ucrt64/bin/pkg-config --cflags --libs gtk4) -o build/Main.exe && echo 'BUILD SUCCESS'
